def min_instability(n, a):
    if n == 2:
        return 0
    
    a.sort()
    return min(a[n-2] - a[1], a[n-1] - a[2])

def min_instability(n, a):
    a.sort()
    # Calculate the initial instability
    initial_instability = a[-1] - a[0]
    # The minimum instability is achieved by removing one of the extreme values
    min_possible_instability = min(initial_instability, a[-2] - a[0], a[-1] - a[1])
    return min_possible_instability
